channel.title: Michael McIntyre's Big Show
channel.desc: BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with a brand-new episode of his Big Show, for an unmissable night of family entertainment at London's prestigious Theatre Royal Drury Lane. Holly Willoughby plays new game Remember Me, Perrie Edwards is awoken for an epic Midnight game show, McFly v Busted give a spectacular performance, and a heartwarming Unexpected Star of the Show gets the surprise of their life.
